Q6120.reason: Maddison-style estimates put 1850 US GDP per capita at roughly $4-5k in 2011 PPP dollars, which is closest to $3k. The note's claim of a $1-a-day subsistence level doesn't match that.

Q5584.reason: My recollection of Pew 2019 is that Italy was around 70%, which fits the note's range of two-thirds to four-fifths.

Q5999.reason: Gallup-type data shows the South's approval trailing the rest of the country by roughly 40-50 points, not nearly the full scale, so South minus rest is about -40.

Q5113.reason: The State Department is the executive department that helps design and carry out foreign policy. The NSC is an advisory body in the Executive Office and not a department with embassies.

Q5743.reason: Japan's 1950 GDP per capita was about $3-4k in 2011 PPP dollars and about $38-40k in 2016, which is roughly a 10-fold increase.
